place_fields.vibe: Historic hill-fort trek with panoramic views
place_fields.summary: Hutridurga is a historic hilltop fort in Tumakuru district, described by the district administration as one of the nine Navadurgas around Bengaluru. The hill has fortifications, bastions, watchtowers, gateways and the Shankareshwara temple.

planning_attributes.description: A hilltop fort and trekking destination surrounded by greenery, with panoramic views of nearby hills and valleys.
planning_attributes.elevation_or_height: About 4,000 feet above sea level (Tumakuru District Administration).
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The district administration dates the fort to the 16th century and attributes its construction to Kempegowda. It says the fort was later associated with Hyder Ali and Tipu Sultan and was conquered by the British in 1791.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Reach Hutridurga by road; the district administration says buses and taxis are available from Bengaluru. Tumkur is the nearest railway station cited there, about 60 km away.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The district administration describes the trek to the top as somewhat challenging.
planning_attributes.notes: The district administration says the fort is believed to have had seven tiers of fortification and includes water-storage works and an underground spring tunnel.

place_fields.vibe: Short, offbeat hill trek with rural panoramic views
place_fields.summary: Aramanekallu Betta is a lesser-known trekking hill near Tumakuru. Indiahikes lists it among regional treks, describing the trail as poorly defined and the starting point as difficult to find, with panoramic views from the top.
place_fields.best_time: Post-monsoon, when the surrounding landscape is greener

planning_attributes.description: A small hill trekking destination in the Tumakuru region offering views over the surrounding rural landscape.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The trail start is not easy to find. Indiahikes recommends contacting the Tumakuru Forest office before attempting the trek.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: The hill is in reserved forest; Indiahikes says it is not listed on the Aranya Vihara website and recommends contacting the Tumakuru Forest office before venturing there.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The trail is not well defined and the starting point is difficult to identify; navigation requires care.
planning_attributes.notes: IndiaHikes places Aramanekallu Betta about 12 km from the Chinaga Betta trek and describes it as an adventure-oriented regional trek.

place_fields.vibe: Beginner-friendly forest and hill trek with fort ruins and cave temples
place_fields.summary: The Tumakuru Ramadevarabetta is a lesser-known hill trek in the Thimlapura Wildlife Sanctuary. The route passes eucalyptus and bamboo forest, boulders and cave temples before reaching a hilltop with ruined fort structures and panoramic views.

planning_attributes.description: A short trek through forest and rocky terrain to a hilltop containing fort ruins, temples, a small waterbody and views over Tumakuru.
planning_attributes.elevation_or_height: Indiahikes gives a highest altitude of 3,800 ft; Mapcarta lists the Ramadevara Betta peak at 1,177 m, so published elevation figures differ.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Indiahikes says the ruined fort's origins are unknown but it is believed to date to around 400 AD; local folklore connects the hill and its sacred waterbody with Rama and Sita.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Indiahikes identifies Booraga Marada Palya village as the trek base, near the boundary of Thimlapura Wildlife Sanctuary; it says the start is about 3 km from Kyatsandra and accessible by road.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: A permit from Aranya Vihaara is required. Indiahikes also recommends returning by the same route because the alternative descent is overgrown and easy to get lost on.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The trail is considered easy and beginner-friendly, but there are intersecting trails and navigation can be difficult; use the documented GPX route or a local guide.
planning_attributes.notes: This Tumakuru Ramadevarabetta is distinct from the Ramadevarabetta Vulture Sanctuary/temple site in Ramanagara, according to Indiahikes.
